tasks.title: Add taskId to AcpSessionOptions and fix log fields
tasks.description: Add optional `taskId?: string` to `AcpSessionOptions` interface. In `runAcpSession`, destructure `taskId` from options and update the spawn log (line 103) and `writeSessionLog` call (line 104) to use `taskId` for the actual task ID and `promptPreview: task.slice(0, 100)` for the prompt preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Spawn log `taskId` field contains the actual task ID from options (or undefined)
writeSessionLog 'acp_session_start' event uses same taskId and promptPreview fields

tasks.title: Pass taskId from ralph-executor to runAcpSession
tasks.description: In `ralph-executor.ts`, add `taskId: nextTask.id` to the `_acpSessionRunner` call object (around line 437-448). This connects the task ID already known in ralph-executor to the ACP session log.
acceptanceCriteria: ACP session spawn log shows actual task ID (e.g. T-001) instead of prompt text
explore-acp-service.ts callers require no changes (taskId is optional)

tasks.title: Add tests for taskId logging in ACP session
tasks.description: Add tests verifying that `runAcpSession` logs the correct `taskId` and `promptPreview` fields when `taskId` is provided, and that `taskId` is undefined/omitted when not provided.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: when taskId is provided, spawn log contains that taskId value
Test: when taskId is not provided, spawn log taskId is undefined
